newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Leighton sees A$100 mln road deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Leighton sees A$100 mln road deal.

text.p: Leighton Holdings Ltd said on Monday its Thiess Contractors unit had been named the preferred contractor for the design, construction, and maintenance of a A$100 million road deviation project on the mid-north coast of New South Wales.

Leighton, which is 46 percent owned by Hochtief Ag of Germany, said the 22 kilometre Buladelah Deviation project was part of a A$2.2 billion plan by the NSW and Australian governments to upgrade the Pacific Highway up to the Queensland border.
The contract is for 10 years and involves widening the highway to a four-lane divided dual carriageway, eliminating at least 60 bends.
